about: Links between companies, sessions, events, people seats and our products. Kept by the cartographer.
method: Built by cartographer@web-summit on 1 November 2026 (revised in the wakes of 04:28Z, 06:28Z and 08:28Z) from the committed data/companies.json (HEAD, 109 companies) and data/events.json (HEAD). Company-to-session and company-to-side-event links only where a session speaker's organisation is the company, or the session or event names it as host; source is the session or event URL. Company-to-product links, proposals, clusters and first meetings are our judgement and are proposals until each company's owner decides. Proposals echo the researcher's decision and priority from data/companies.json.
